qaCases.positiveFixture: Separate current certificate, proof and ledger rows retain their own owners and scopes
qaCases.negativeFixtureAndExpectedReport: Label one K6 proof as universal or ledger-authenticated: incompatible evidence class; requested closure remains open

qaCases.positiveFixture: All original scenario names survive in their proper inventory
qaCases.negativeFixtureAndExpectedReport: Remove a required scenario but preserve total count with a duplicate: inventory integrity failure

qaCases.positiveFixture: Legacy Preview result stays visible as historical legacy evidence
qaCases.negativeFixtureAndExpectedReport: Relabel it Rust/Preprod without approved mapping: applicability unestablished

qaCases.positiveFixture: Public VK reference, its digest and owner-qualified provenance are distinct
qaCases.negativeFixtureAndExpectedReport: Digest-only capsule claims public pairing reproducibility or Class-0 becomes ceremony-backed: unsupported declaration

qaCases.positiveFixture: Unchanged consumed dependencies preserve an owner declaration's computed currentness
qaCases.negativeFixtureAndExpectedReport: Change semantics, script parameter, VK, bounds or oracle pin: all transitively affected declarations become non-current; history retained

qaCases.positiveFixture: Adopted result references the exact candidate and actual-result review
qaCases.negativeFixtureAndExpectedReport: Source review or renderer attribution offered as full-builder/result acceptance: missing scoped review

qaCases.positiveFixture: Issued, referenced and consumed claim outputs are distinct events
qaCases.negativeFixtureAndExpectedReport: Claim reference input labelled consumption, or proof verification labelled issuance: missing observation of required event

qaCases.positiveFixture: Sequential settlements have ordered references; atomic settlement has one joint body and complete input set
qaCases.negativeFixtureAndExpectedReport: Combine separate transaction receipts into atomic closure or omit one required input: incomplete atomic evidence

qaCases.positiveFixture: Proof, C2, VI and S2′ identities match the declared reviewed DAG
qaCases.negativeFixtureAndExpectedReport: Swap a script identity or omit FV-02 restriction: inconsistent dependency/unsupported composition declaration

qaCases.positiveFixture: Preserve D7 1/13/0 result and review-pending state
qaCases.negativeFixtureAndExpectedReport: Convert expected missing-implementation failures into checker passes: invalid scope promotion; keep original result

qaCases.positiveFixture: Separate nominal charge, observed wall and unknown transitive CPU; separate script bytes and transaction costs
qaCases.negativeFixtureAndExpectedReport: Present K6 nominal CPU or 14,336 B as measured proof CPU or a protocol limit: mismatched metric/provenance

qaCases.positiveFixture: Submission, refusal, inclusion, readback and finality remain distinct
qaCases.negativeFixtureAndExpectedReport: Callback success, timeout or provider evaluation labelled settled: missing ledger/finality evidence

qaCases.positiveFixture: Full financial comparison includes gross debit, fees, net receipts, frame, liabilities and residual duties
qaCases.negativeFixtureAndExpectedReport: Omit a required effect or duty field while retaining a pass summary: incomplete comparison

qaCases.positiveFixture: Recursion, private handoff and multi-parent rows stay open beside a public-only success
qaCases.negativeFixtureAndExpectedReport: Collapse those rows into a single PCD pass or delete an unsupported family: inventory/claim-scope failure

qaCases.positiveFixture: Complete all-open inventory yields integrity success and selected closure failure
qaCases.negativeFixtureAndExpectedReport: Infer product success from integrity exit 0 or a synthetic reporting fixture: reject closure declaration

qaCases.positiveFixture: Explicit allowlisted public relative file refs resolve without executing content
qaCases.negativeFixtureAndExpectedReport: Absolute/traversal/symlink-escape/private refs or command strings offered as inputs: report invalid reference and do not follow/execute
